_meta.title: Scotland: hate crimes recorded by the police, by council area, 2014-15 to 2024-25
_meta.measures: Crimes recorded by Police Scotland with one or more hate aggravators (race, religion, sexual orientation, transgender identity, disability; age and variations in sex characteristics added from April 2024). value = hate_crimes in the latest financial year (April-March). rate_per_10000 = crimes per 10,000 population, as published. The "Scotland" feature (no geometry) also carries the national tables: aggravator_*, crime_type_*, crime_type_by_aggravator_* (_n = number, _pct = proportion %).
notes: 2024-25 is the first year under the Hate Crime and Public Order (Scotland) Act 2021 (in force 1 April 2024). The bulletin says: "it is not possible to provide a like-for-like comparison with the period prior to the Act being implemented."
2014-15 to 2023-24 come from the 2023-24 research paper tables; 2024-25 from the 2024-25 statistical bulletin tables.
Not included: the 2024-25 bulletin tables 6-14 (national, sample-based victim/perpetrator characteristics and prejudice shown, percentages only).
_meta.source: Scottish Government, "Hate crimes recorded by the police in Scotland, 2023-24" and "..., 2024-25"
